title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Sharing
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends explore the magic of sharing! Bella has a wonderful idea to show everyone how sharing makes playtime even more fun. Together, they learn that sharing brings smiles and happiness.
lesson: Kids learn the importance of sharing with friends.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Marjona, and Twinkle are playing with toys together. They are having lots of fun but notice some toys are not being used.
Bella hops over and asks, 'What if we share our toys? It could be more fun!' The friends look at each other and smile.
Bobo, with his red bow tie, says, 'Sharing is a great idea! I can share my big blocks!' The others nod excitedly.
Marjona looks at Twinkle and says, 'What about sharing our snack too? I brought yummy cookies!' Twinkle glows happily.
They all gather and start sharing their toys and snacks. Each friend takes turns using the blocks and enjoying cookies.
As they play, Baby Leo notices that everyone is smiling and laughing more. He says, 'This is so much fun!'
Twinkle sprinkles a little sparkle magic and says, 'Sharing shines bright, like me!' Everyone giggles.
After playtime, they sit in a circle and talk about how good it felt to share. Marjona sings a happy song about sharing.
Bobo hugs his friends and says, 'We should always share!' They all cheer.
The friends finish the day with big smiles, knowing sharing makes everything better.
